item.title: ERC Projects Database: Research Tool for Scientists and Research Offices
item.description:
Last reviewed and updated on 27 October 2026.

Domain Focus: Scientific research funding and impact intelligence
Services: Data engineering and cleaning, information architecture, web development, technical SEO
Tools: Python, Google Sheets, Hugo, GitHub Pages, Claude Code, Google Search Console
Date: September 2026
Live page: pranoti.thesciencetalk.com/erc-projects-database

Executive Summary

Winning a European Research Council (ERC) grant takes precise positioning. Principal investigators and research offices must study the grants already funded in their scheme and panel to show novelty, frame ambition and benchmark a proposal. The data is public, in the European Commission’s Qlik dashboard, but that dashboard is dense, hard to filter and easy to lose your place in.

item.title: How to Restore a Single WordPress Page from a WP Engine Backup
item.description:
WordPress has no native “restore single page from backup” feature. WP Engine’s backup system saves your entire site, database and files, as one package. To restore one page, you must go into the raw database dump and extract it yourself.

This post documents exactly how to do this: extract a single page from a WP Engine full-site database backup and restore it to WordPress via the REST API, section by section, without touching anything else on the site.
